content.name: Diplomacy Agents
content.description:
X4 9.00 gives every faction an agent you can hire and send on negotiation and espionage actions. Agents learn slowly - an action pays 1 to 15 experience and the top rank, Spymaster, sits at 400 - and the interesting actions are the ones that can leave an agent injured for twenty minutes or kill them outright, taking all of their experience with them.
This mod turns those numbers into sliders. Every slider starts at the vanilla value, so installing it changes nothing until you turn one up.
[h2]Settings[/h2] [list] [*][b]Agent experience multiplier[/b] - 1 to 20, vanilla 1. Multiplies the experience an agent earns per action. It applies before the game splits the roll between the two skills, so the fifth that goes to the off-skill scales with it. [*][b]Experience when injured[/b] - 0 to 100 percent, vanilla 0. An agent that comes back injured gets this percentage of a no-risk experience roll, split between both skills. Worth knowing: vanilla already pays experience for a failed action the agent walks away from. What it never pays for is an action that puts the agent in the infirmary, and that is the gap this fills. [*][b]Agent risk[/b] - 0 to 100 percent, vanilla 100. Scales the injury and death chances a failed risky action rolls against. At 0 an agent can never be hurt or killed. [*][b]Agents can die[/b] - on or off, vanilla on. Off caps the worst a risky action can do at an injury. It does not change how often one happens - that is the slider above. [*][b]Agent gender[/b] - 0 any, 1 female, 2 male, vanilla 0. Which agents the factions put up for hire from now on. Agents you already know keep the gender they were born with; fire one and the faction sends a replacement 30 to 60 minutes of game time later. [/list]
[h2]Where to change them[/h2] With SirNukes Mod Support APIs installed, all five sit in [b]Options - Extension Options - Diplomacy Agents[/b]. Changes apply to the next action or the next agent, with no reload. Settings are stored in the savegame, so each save carries its own.
Without that API the mod behaves exactly the same, configured from the constants at the top of md/drjele_diplomacy_agents.xml instead: $XpFactor, $InjuredXpPercent, $RiskPercent, $AgentsCanDie and $AgentGender. They are re-read on every savegame load, so editing one and reloading is enough - no new game is needed. Any other mod or cheat menu can also override each of them at runtime through the globals $DrJeleDiplomacyXpFactor, $DrJeleDiplomacyInjuredXpPercent, $DrJeleDiplomacyRiskPercent, $DrJeleDiplomacyAgentsCanDie and $DrJeleDiplomacyAgentGender.
[h2]Dependencies[/h2] [list] [*][b]X4: Foundations 9.00[/b] - required. [*][b]SirNukes Mod Support APIs[/b] - optional, and only for the in-game options menu. Everything else works without it. [*][b]X4: Timelines[/b] - optional, and only for the Quettanaut agent character. Without the DLC that faction does not exist either. [*]No other DLC is required. The DLCs are supported where they add agents, but nothing depends on them. [/list]
[h2]About the gender filter[/h2] It reaches fifteen of the twenty-one factions that field an agent. Eleven of them already ship an agent character in each gender and need nothing from the mod. Four more get their gendered characters from it: the Teladi-race factions - Teladi Company, Ministry of Finance and Scale Plate Pact - whose single group holding both genders is split in two, and the Quettanauts, whose one character is bound to the male group, so in the base game a Quettanaut agent can only ever be male.
Six factions cannot be done at all, and no mod can do better: Paranid, Holy Order, Alliance, Trinity, Duke's Buccaneers and the Boron. Their agents come from a race the game holds no female model for.
[h2]Notes[/h2] Works on an existing savegame, and comes back off one. It patches four spots in two vanilla scripts and adds no cues of its own beyond a configuration block.
Source, full documentation and the file-based configuration: https://github.com/drjele/x4-diplomacy-agents

text.name: Diplomacy Agents
text.description: Sliders for the diplomacy agents: an experience multiplier, experience for agents that come back injured, a scale on the injury and death chances of risky actions, a switch that stops an agent being killed outright, and a filter that makes the agents factions offer you all female or all male - including the Quettanauts, who in the base game can only ever offer men. Everything starts at the vanilla value, so the mod changes nothing until you turn a slider up. Works on an existing savegame.
